verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only an official MCP server that lets external, third-party AI assistants manage a Mailgun account conversationally. That is an adjacent integration feature, not a built-in AI assistant inside Mailgun's own product or control panel. No evidence shows an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
